name: Repair and verify release
command:
set -eu
repair_dir=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/esbuild-repair.XXXXXX")
npm pack @esbuild/darwin-arm64@0.28.2 --pack-destination "$repair_dir"
tar -xzf "$repair_dir/esbuild-darwin-arm64-0.28.2.tgz" -C "$repair_dir"
rm node_modules/@esbuild/darwin-arm64/bin/esbuild
cp "$repair_dir/package/bin/esbuild" node_modules/@esbuild/darwin-arm64/bin/esbuild
chmod +x node_modules/@esbuild/darwin-arm64/bin/esbuild
node_modules/@esbuild/darwin-arm64/bin/esbuild --version
npm test
npm run typecheck
git diff --check
